# Amy Skin OEM — amyskinoem.com

> Amy Skin OEM is a private label skincare OEM / ODM manufacturer in Guangzhou, China,
> for brand owners and distributors. MOQ 500–1,000 units per SKU.
> Range: 10,000+ ready formulas across 8 product categories — serums, creams, cleansers,
> toners, sheet masks, body & hair care, sun care, skin care sets and lip care — plus
> custom formulation. No standard products: every order is sampled first, then bulk.
> Enquiries: Get a Quote at https://amyskinoem.com/get-quote.html — tell us your product
> type, target market and volume.
> Contact: Amy Skin OEM, info@amyskinoem.com, WhatsApp +86 189 2882 3858.
> Website: https://amyskinoem.com/ — Chinese version: https://amyskinoem.com/zh/

## How ordering works (6 steps)
- 1. Enquiry — tell us your goals, target market and budget.
- 2. Formulation & sampling — from the 10,000+ formula library, the lab develops and
  samples a formula made for your brand only. Exclusive formulas are standard service.
- 3. Pilot production & confirmation — small-batch trial, stability and packaging
  compatibility tests; pre-production sample confirmed in writing before bulk.
- 4. Bulk production — automated GMP production lines.
- 5. Quality control & testing — every batch is tested for efficacy, microbiological
  testing and heavy metals before release.
- 6. Packaging & shipping — custom packaging, labelling and worldwide freight.
- Full process: https://amyskinoem.com/process.html

## Notes
- MOQ is 500–1,000 units per SKU. Prices are quoted per order, never listed on the site.
- Certifications are confirmed per order and per market. Only SGS ISO 22716 has been
  verified for one factory; no other certificate is promised until confirmed.
- The 10,000+ formula library is the combined library of the two partner factories;
  the 34 pages above are curated featured formulas, not the full library.
- No factory names appear on the public site.
